items.stem: What is the primary function of the power inverter in a battery electric vehicle?

options.text: To step the 12 V battery up to high voltage for the cabin heater
options.rationale: That is the role of a DC-DC converter and PTC heater, not the traction inverter.

options.text: To convert the battery's DC into controlled AC to drive the traction motor
options.rationale: The inverter converts DC pack output into variable-frequency AC to control motor torque and speed.

options.text: To store surplus energy during regenerative braking
options.rationale: Energy is stored in the battery; the inverter manages conversion, not storage.

options.text: To filter coolant through the battery pack
options.rationale: Coolant flow is handled by the thermal management system, not the inverter.

items.explanation: The inverter converts DC pack output into variable-frequency AC to control motor torque and speed.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why does DC fast charging typically slow down as the battery approaches a high state of charge?

options.text: The charger runs out of electricity
options.rationale: The supply is not exhausted; the vehicle limits the rate.

options.text: The battery management system reduces current to protect the cells
options.rationale: At high state of charge the BMS tapers current to limit cell voltage and avoid damage or lithium plating.

options.text: The connector physically shrinks when warm
options.rationale: Connector geometry does not change the charge taper.

options.text: Regenerative braking takes over the charging
options.rationale: Regen is unrelated to stationary DC charging behaviour.

items.explanation: At high state of charge the BMS tapers current to limit cell voltage and avoid damage or lithium plating.

items.stem: An engineer must make a BEV safe before touching the high-voltage system. Select TWO actions that are essential parts of a safe de-energisation procedure.

options.text: Remove or open the high-voltage service disconnect
options.rationale: Opening the service disconnect physically isolates the pack from the HV bus.

options.text: Verify the absence of voltage with a rated meter after a wait period
options.rationale: Confirming zero voltage after capacitor discharge is essential before contact.

options.text: Simply switch off the cabin infotainment
options.rationale: Infotainment is a low-voltage load and does not isolate the HV system.

options.text: Rev the motor to drain the battery
options.rationale: This neither isolates nor safely discharges the HV system.

options.text: Disconnect only the 12 V auxiliary battery
options.rationale: The 12 V battery is not the high-voltage hazard source.

items.explanation: Opening the service disconnect physically isolates the pack from the HV bus.
